serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
You: Hello Big Daddy.
Big Daddy: Hello little one.
#BigDaddyHurt.Face.bdhSerious
Big Daddy: …
Big Daddy: From your face I read that our plan wasn’t successful…
You: I’m sorry, I couldn’t do it after all.
Big Daddy: What happened?
Should I tell him the truth or lie? He’s a very nice guy, but even he has a breaking point.
You: W-well, that Admin guy was a little intimidating and when he started asking questions about technical stuff, I told him that I’m not the right guy for the job and left…
Big Daddy: Damn! All this preparing for nothing!
You: I’m sorry…
Big Daddy: AHHHHHH! ARE YOU KIDDING ME?!{{punch}}
I never saw him this angry before…
It seemed like he wanted to reach me with his hands, but he stopped in the middle and regained his composure.
Big Daddy: Eh…
Big Daddy: Maybe it’s my fault. I didn’t prepare you for this talk enough.
Oh no! I will feel bad if he starts blaming himself for this!
You: N-no, it’s not your fault Big Daddy, it was all my fault! I fucked up.
Big Daddy: Well, it doesn’t matter now. We will get him next time.
Big Daddy: Not all is lost though. I recorded your phone call with DAK and tracked his phone. We got him.
You: Really?! That’s great!{{wi}} How did you do it though?
Big Daddy: Oh, I cloned your phone, remember?
You: Yeah. I just didn’t know cloning a phone allows something like that.
Big Daddy: Listen Anon, I don’t want to sound crude, but it’s kinda late and I’m tired…
Big Daddy: I’m kinda disappointed how all of this turned out and I need a little time to think.
You: Oh, no problem. I will leave.
Big Daddy: Thanks.
